items.question_en: What is your favorite way to memorize new English words?
items.question_ko: 새로운 영어 단어를 외우는 너의 가장 좋아하는 방법은?
items.sample_answer_en: I prefer using flashcards because they let me review words repeatedly until I really remember them.

items.question_en: Do you study better in the morning or at night? Why?
items.question_ko: 아침에 공부가 더 잘되는지, 밤에 더 잘되는지? 왜?
items.sample_answer_en: I study better in the morning because my mind is fresh and there are fewer distractions.

items.question_en: Have you ever experienced forgetting something important right before a test?
items.question_ko: 시험 직전 중요한 것을 잊어버린 경험이 있어?
items.sample_answer_en: Yes, once during a math test I completely forgot a formula I had memorized just an hour before. It made me realize how important spaced practice is.

items.question_en: If you could improve one cognitive skill, which would you choose and why?
items.question_ko: 한 가지 인지 능력을 향상시킬 수 있다면, 어떤 것을 선택하고 왜?
items.sample_answer_en: I would choose deep focus. In today's world full of distractions, the ability to concentrate for long periods feels like a superpower.

items.question_en: What is the most useful thing you have learned this year?
items.question_ko: 올해 배운 것 중 가장 유용한 것은?
items.sample_answer_en: The most useful thing I learned this year is how to break large tasks into smaller ones. It changed how I approach studying.

items.question_en: Do you think smartphones help or hurt our memory? Why?
items.question_ko: 스마트폰은 우리 기억력에 도움이 된다고 생각해, 해친다고 생각해? 왜?
items.sample_answer_en: I think they hurt our memory because we rely on them to store everything, so our brains don't get the practice they need.

items.question_en: Can you describe a teacher who had a profound impact on you?
items.question_ko: 너에게 깊은 영향을 준 선생님을 묘사할 수 있어?
items.sample_answer_en: My middle school science teacher had a profound impact on me. She made every lesson feel like an adventure.

items.question_en: What do you do when you feel stuck while studying?
items.question_ko: 공부하다 막혔을 때 너는 무엇을 해?
items.sample_answer_en: When I feel stuck, I take a short walk. Often the answer comes to me when I stop forcing it.

items.question_en: Is it better to learn many things at a basic level, or to master one thing deeply?
items.question_ko: 여러 가지를 기초 수준으로 배우는 것이 나아, 아니면 한 가지를 깊이 마스터하는 것이 나아?
items.sample_answer_en: I think it depends on the goal. For a hobby, breadth is fun. But for a career, deep mastery usually wins.

items.question_en: If you could design the perfect study environment, what would it look like?
items.question_ko: 완벽한 학습 환경을 설계할 수 있다면, 어떤 모습일까?
items.sample_answer_en: My perfect study space would be quiet, with natural light, a clean desk, and absolutely no phone within reach.
